sum: Presidio Production Company, an independent energy company, engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and production of oil and natural gas properties in the United States. The company holds operated and non-operated proved developed producing wells that produce oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids located throughout Texas, Oklahoma, and Kansas. It also provides field services, including compression, FLIR surveys, emissions reduction equipment, tubing scanning, and line locating services, with compression and FLIR surveys. The company is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.
ceo: Mr. William A. Ulrich (Chairman of Board, Founder & Co-CEO)
